text: Request to re-open Item SC26.1 Request for Fence Exemption- 110 Lynnbrook Drive, Fence in Front Yard, to permit the exemption.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item SC26.1 - Request for Fence Exemption- 110 Lynnbrook Drive - Fence in Front Yard for consideration. 2. Granted the request for a fence exemption permit at 110 Lynnbrook Drive.
